resources.string: Reminders only work when every row is green. Come back here after changing a setting.
Every reminder is delivered as a notification, even when it also pops up.
Lets reminders fire at the exact minute instead of being batched later.
Each reminder level has its own notification channel. If one is turned off or made quieter in phone settings, those reminders hide or stay silent.
Lets the full-screen pop-up appear on top of the app you are using.
Lets the pop-up wake the screen when the phone is locked.
Stops the phone from putting the app to sleep and delaying reminders.
Lets reminders come back after a restart.
Vivo blocks pop-ups from apps in the background unless this is on.
Vivo hides pop-ups on the lock screen unless this is on.
Stops \"clear all\" in recent apps from killing the app and its reminders.
Open settings, then Battery usage → Background power control → Allow background power usage.
Phone Settings → Apps → Special app access → Autostart → turn on BetterLife.
Not confirmed on OriginOS 6: try phone Settings → Security & privacy → Permission manager, and look for a background pop-up option for BetterLife.
Not confirmed on OriginOS 6: try phone Settings → Apps → Special app access → Turn screen on, and allow BetterLife. Also check Permission manager for a lock screen option.
Open recent apps, then pull down on the BetterLife card (or long-press it) and tap Lock. Not confirmed on OriginOS 6.
Notifications are off for this app.
A reminder channel is turned off, so those reminders never appear.
A reminder channel was made quieter than the app set it, so those reminders may not pop up or make a sound.
Drawing over other apps is not allowed.
The phone may restrict this app in the background.
The app can\'t check this. Tick it once you\'ve turned it on.
